title: Primal-dual algorithm for distributed optimization: A dissipativity-based perspective
summary: We study a continuous-time primal-dual algorithm for distributed optimization with nonconvex local cost functions over weight-unbalanced digraphs, and analyze its performance from a dissipativity-based perspective. We first reformulate the algorithm as a Lure type system, consisting of a linear subsystem that relies on the communication topology and the algorithm gains, and a static nonlinear gradient feedback.
